      "text": "The following is a simple usage example that sums integers from the command-line and writes the result to a file.",
      "quote": "\"The following is a simple usage example that sums integers from the command-line and writes the result to a file::\n\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description='sum the integers at the command line')\n    parser.add_argument(\n        'integers', metavar='int', nargs='+', type=int,\n        help='an integer to be summed')\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--log',\n        help='the file where the sum should be written')\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    with (open(args.log, 'w') if args.log is not None\n          else contextlib.nullcontext(sys.stdout)) as log:\n        log.write('%s' % sum(args.integers))\"",
